transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net fiber technical faults, my name is Craig. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello, my name is Wesley Cox. Following an electrical lightning storm and power surge in our street last night, our fiber broadband has died completely and the wall-mounted optical network terminal has a solid red 'LOS' alarm light shining on the front, leaving our entire family with zero internet!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can check the optical status. What is your fiber ONT serial number and account number?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The ONT serial is SN-ONT-449102, account SN-771920, registered to 15 Orchard Close, Taunton, TA1 4NE, security PIN 8812.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me open the Taunton fiber headend optical distribution console.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Please check why the red LOS light is on.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Could I place you on hold for two minutes while I query the passive optical splitter port registers?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding. The optical line terminal at the telephone exchange shows an unrecoverable signal fault on your fiber port.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: An unrecoverable signal fault?! S-Net charged us two hundred pounds for this fiber installation and guaranteed uninterrupted gigabit reliability! Now a single rainstorm knocks out our internet and leaves a red light on my wall! This equipment is flimsy rubbish and I am furious!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand your frustration and anger, especially having invested two hundred pounds in fiber installation and expecting resilient gigabit service only to have a power surge disrupt your connection. Let us investigate what happened so we can get your line restored.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Craig, please fix it as soon as possible.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Power surges can damage internal optoelectronic diodes on the ONT board.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you replace the damaged optical hardware as soon as possible?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am stating the standard causes of optical receiver burnout.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Craig? Are you still there? The line was dead for forty seconds!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I was waiting for the Taunton OLT line card diagnostics to refresh.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you reset the fiber port from your end?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously optical LOS indicates complete loss of incoming laser light that cannot be fixed by software reboots.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So the laser fiber cable itself is severed or dead?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The optical receiver diode inside your ONT has failed or the external fiber pigtail is broken.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you dispatch an engineer to replace the ONT today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Wesley speaking, I am a freelance digital animator and 3D visual effects director, and at five o'clock today I have a non-negotiable delivery deadline for a thirty-second Super Bowl television commercial render! If I fail to upload these visual effects files to the Hollywood studio servers by five o'clock, the advertising agency will cancel our six-figure contract, our production studio will go bankrupt, and all seven of my staff will be laid off! I am having severe chest pains and a complete panic breakdown!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The earliest Openreach specialized optical repair appointment is Monday afternoon between one and six o'clock.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Monday afternoon?! Did you not hear a single word I just said about Hollywood studio servers and bankruptcy?! Are you completely deaf or do you just enjoy watching customers suffer?!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If you run a commercial digital animation studio from a residential broadband line, that is your own reckless negligence and poor planning.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you not offer an emergency mobile broadband backup or 4G router right now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Emergency 4G backup dongles can be collected from an S-Net retail store.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Where is the nearest retail store with stock?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The nearest store is at the Taunton Orchard Shopping Centre.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Will they hand me a 4G router if I show my account number?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: They require photo identification and account confirmation.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will drive to the shopping centre immediately.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Craig?! Hello?! Did you vanish again?! Why does your phone line keep going silent for forty seconds?!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I was booking the Monday afternoon optical engineering appointment.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Is the appointment confirmed?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The engineering visit is booked for Monday between 1:00 PM and 6:00 PM.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Give me the booking reference number.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your engineering appointment reference is FBR-REP-88192-T.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: FBR-REP-88192-T, noted down.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The engineer will replace the wall-mounted optical terminal.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will collect the 4G backup unit from the retail store right now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Before we conclude, what was that fiber ONT serial number again?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: As I told you right at the start of our call, it is SN-ONT-449102.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, serial number confirmed on the ticket.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Your customer service was cold and appalling.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there any other query today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net fiber technical faults. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.
